base_principles.label: Field Primacy
base_principles.statement: All information in FFT is represented as field signals traversing a structured field space.

base_principles.label: Resonance-Time
base_principles.statement: Temporal dynamics are governed by resonance rather than linear time. RTT nodes model resonant temporal states.

base_principles.label: Triadic Structure
base_principles.statement: Every field interaction is triadic: Temporal (T), Structural (S), and Modal (M) axes are always co-present.

base_principles.label: Harmonic Resolution
base_principles.statement: All paradox escalations MUST resolve harmonically. Resolution restores coherence and resets the lattice.

base_principles.label: 3C Condition Primacy
base_principles.statement: Coherence, Clarity, and Continuity are the fundamental health conditions of every field state.

base_principles.label: Autonomous Alignment
base_principles.statement: Alignment is a spectrum from passive observation (AA0) to full autonomous self-alignment (AA3).

base_principles.label: Substrate Relativity
base_principles.statement: All operator capabilities are substrate-relative. No operation is substrate-independent.

base_principles.label: Canon Consistency
base_principles.statement: All files in the AI Edition MUST be internally consistent with spec_version 1.2.0 and the canon invariants.
